purpose: Expose the canonical DS-D1 meta-type inventory and explicit implementation-conformance coverage without changing DomainSpec formation or maturity authority.
claim_ceiling: This derived read model reports the owner-admitted canonical implemented meta-type baseline, bounded static generated-target conformance, and the ontology-v2 example lifecycle axes. It does not establish production runtime conformance and cannot author admission, create a PromotionRecord, grant authority, migrate candidate bytes, publish, release, deploy, or establish production readiness.

meta_types.label: Entity
meta_types.plain_language: An identity-bearing object that is tracked through a lifecycle.
meta_types.mapping_reason: The current owner-admitted baseline binds this backend meta-type to exact TypeScript, Python, and Rust source, provider, and binding digests. Historical candidate coverage remains provenance only.
meta_types.review_trigger: Exact providers and native fixtures prove every admitted construction route, base-before-extension validation, stable typed identity through reconstruction and lifecycle transitions, identity-only equality and hashing, immutable snapshots, and acyclic additive extension.

meta_types.label: Value Object
meta_types.plain_language: An immutable value whose identity is its complete field tuple.
meta_types.mapping_reason: The current owner-admitted baseline binds this backend meta-type to exact TypeScript, Python, and Rust source, provider, and binding digests. Historical candidate coverage remains provenance only.
meta_types.review_trigger: Exact providers and native fixtures prove validation order, formation failure, recursive immutability, complete per-component equality, congruent hashing, and extension preservation without widening the component domain.

meta_types.review_trigger: A provider or catalogue digest changes, a native protocol accepts aliases or unknown wires, or cross-language proof reveals a portable property gap.

obligations: no undeclared read, write or effect
typed relationships to Rule, Event and Workflow
